title: Are Black Holes Actually Fuzzballs?
summary: A PBS Space Time episode on fuzzballs, the string-theory proposal for black holes that replaces the singularity with a tangle of strings. It explains why black holes seem to both have to exist and break known physics.
why: Cited as an accessible pointer when threads discuss black hole models that avoid singularities.

quote.text: PBS space time goes into a few of them
